      <defs>
        <radialGradient
          cx="0"
          cy="0"
          gradientTransform="matrix(16.1326 5.4553 -43.70045 129.2322 1.588 6.503)"
          gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
          id="pi-gemini-grad"
          r="1"
        >
          <stop offset=".067" stopColor="#9168C0" />
          <stop offset=".343" stopColor="#5684D1" />
          <stop offset=".672" stopColor="#1BA1E3" />
        </radialGradient>
      </defs>
    </svg>
  );
}

const escapeHtml = (str: string) =>
  str.replaceAll(
    /[&<>]/g,
    (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;" })[c] ?? c
  );

export interface PromptInputMessage {
  /** Plain text of the editor (skill/source pills contribute their labels). */
  text: string;
  modelId: string;
  /** Ids of the skill pills present in the message, in document order. */
  skillIds: string[];
  /** Ids of the @ source pills present in the message, in document order. */
  sourceIds: string[];
  attachments: PromptInputAttachment[];
}

/** Shape of the composer shell. Matches `prompt-bar`: card corners vs full pill. */
export type PromptInputVariant = "Rounded" | "Pill";

export interface PromptInputProps {
  /** Merged onto the root wrapper — override sizing, fonts, or any `--pi-*` token. */
  className?: string;
  /**
   * Composer shape. `Rounded` uses card radius on the frame and squarer
   * controls; `Pill` goes fully round (and softens to 24px once attachments
   * expand the height).
   * @default "Rounded"
   */
  variant?: PromptInputVariant;
  placeholder?: string;
  models?: PromptInputModel[];
  skills?: PromptInputSkill[];
  /** @-mentionable data sources / connectors. */
  sources?: PromptInputSource[];
  /**
   * When true, attachments render as large image thumbnails / smart file
   * cards (Claude-style). When false (default), keep compact truncated pills.
   */
  largeAttachments?: boolean;
  /** Initially selected model. Defaults to the first entry of `models`. */
  defaultModelId?: string;
  /** Called on submit (Enter or the send button) right before the editor clears. */
  onSend?: (message: PromptInputMessage) => void;
  onModelChange?: (modelId: string) => void;
}

// Pill uses a fixed 24px radius: on the ~45px single row the browser clamps it
// to a perfect capsule, and as the frame grows it settles to 24px. The corners
// follow the height animation instead of interpolating 9999px → 24px.
function frameRadiusClass(pill: boolean) {
  return pill ? "rounded-[24px] [--pi-radius:24px]" : "rounded-(--pi-radius)";
}

interface FrameMorphSnapshot {
  to: boolean;
  height: number;
  offsets: Map<HTMLElement, { x: number; y: number }>;
}

function measureMorphSlots(frame: HTMLElement) {
  const base = frame.getBoundingClientRect();
  const offsets: FrameMorphSnapshot["offsets"] = new Map();
  for (const el of frame.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("[data-morph-slot]")) {
    const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    offsets.set(el, { x: rect.left - base.left, y: rect.top - base.top });
  }
  return offsets;
}

/**
 * The single-row ↔ expanded grid swap reflows instantly. Call `snapshot()`
 * right before toggling `expanded`; the layout effect then plays the frame
 * height and each `[data-morph-slot]` position from the snapshot (FLIP).
 */
function useFrameMorph(expanded: boolean, reduceMotion: boolean | null) {
  const frameRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  // Last painted height. Pills are inserted outside React, so by the time a
  // layout effect runs the DOM may already be taller than what's on screen.
  const paintedHeight = useRef(0);
  const pending = useRef<FrameMorphSnapshot | null>(null);
  const running = useRef<ReturnType<typeof animate>[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const frame = frameRef.current;
    if (!frame) {
      return;
    }
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(() => {
      paintedHeight.current = frame.offsetHeight;
    });
    observer.observe(frame);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);

  const snapshot = useCallback(
    (to: boolean) => {
      const frame = frameRef.current;
      if (!frame || reduceMotion) {
        return;
      }
      pending.current = {
        height: paintedHeight.current || frame.offsetHeight,
        offsets: measureMorphSlots(frame),
        to,
      };
    },
    [reduceMotion]
  );

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const from = pending.current;
    pending.current = null;
    const frame = frameRef.current;
    if (!(from && frame) || from.to !== expanded) {
      return;
    }
    for (const anim of running.current) {
      anim.stop();
    }
    frame.style.height = "";
    for (const el of from.offsets.keys()) {
      el.style.transform = "";
    }
    const toHeight = frame.offsetHeight;
    const toOffsets = measureMorphSlots(frame);
    const options = { duration: 0.22, ease: EASE };

    const frameAnim = animate(
      frame,
      { height: [from.height, toHeight] },
      options
    );
    frameAnim.then(() => {
      if (running.current.includes(frameAnim)) {
        frame.style.height = "";
      }
    });
    running.current = [
      frameAnim,
      ...[...from.offsets].flatMap(([el, prev]) => {
        const next = toOffsets.get(el);
        if (!next) {
          return [];
        }
        return [
          animate(
            el,
            { x: [prev.x - next.x, 0], y: [prev.y - next.y, 0] },
            options
          ),
        ];
      }),
    ];
  }, [expanded]);

  return { frameRef, snapshot };
}

const PALETTE_NAV_KEYS = new Set([
  "ArrowDown",
  "ArrowUp",
  "Enter",
  "Tab",
  "Escape",
]);

const SOLO_TRIGGER_TOKEN = /^(?:\/[^\s/]*|@[^\s@]*)$/;

/**
 * Resolve a collapsed caret inside `editor` to a text node + offset.
 * First keystrokes in an empty contenteditable often leave the selection on
 * the editor element itself (not the text child) — without this, `/` and `@`
 * detection never sees the typed token.
 */
function getCollapsedCaretInEditor(editor: HTMLElement): {
  node: Text;
  offset: number;
  before: string;
} | null {
  const sel = window.getSelection();
  if (!sel || sel.rangeCount === 0 || !sel.isCollapsed) {
    return null;
  }
  const range = sel.getRangeAt(0);
  let node: Node = range.startContainer;
  let offset = range.startOffset;

  if (!editor.contains(node)) {
    return null;
  }

  if (node.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
    const beforeNode = node.childNodes[offset - 1] ?? null;
    const afterNode = node.childNodes[offset] ?? null;
    if (beforeNode?.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) {
      node = beforeNode;
      offset = beforeNode.textContent?.length ?? 0;
    } else if (afterNode?.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) {
      // Some engines report the caret on the host at offset 0 (before the
      // only text child) right after the first `/` or `@` keystroke. Treat
      // that as "at end of the token" so the palette can open.
      const text = afterNode.textContent ?? "";
      const atTokenEnd =
        offset === 0 &&
        node.childNodes.length === 1 &&
        SOLO_TRIGGER_TOKEN.test(text);
      node = afterNode;
      offset = atTokenEnd ? text.length : 0;
    } else {
      return null;
    }
  }

  if (node.nodeType !== Node.TEXT_NODE) {
    return null;
  }

  const textNode = node as Text;
  return {
    before: (textNode.textContent ?? "").slice(0, offset),
    node: textNode,
    offset,
  };
}

// biome-ignore lint/complexity/noExcessiveCognitiveComplexity: single composer surface; splitting would obscure the controlled API and shared editor/palette state.
export function PromptInput({
  className,
  variant = "Rounded",
  placeholder = "Write a message…",
  models = DEFAULT_MODELS,
  skills = DEFAULT_SKILLS,
  sources = DEFAULT_SOURCES,
  largeAttachments = false,
  defaultModelId,
  onSend,
  onModelChange,
}: PromptInputProps = {}) {
  const pill = variant === "Pill";
  // `value` mirrors the editor's plain text (skill/source pills contribute
  // their labels), so it drives the empty/placeholder + send logic.
  const [value, setValue] = useState("");
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [skillsOpen, setSkillsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [sourcesOpen, setSourcesOpen] = useState(false);
  const [hoveredModel, setHoveredModel] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [model, setModel] = useState(
    () => defaultModelId ?? models[0]?.id ?? ""
  );
  const [attachments, setAttachments] = useState<PromptInputAttachment[]>([]);
  const attachmentsRef = useRef<PromptInputAttachment[]>([]);
  // Single-row until the draft wraps (or gains pills) — same idea as prompt-bar.
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);

  // Slash-command palette (typing "/" opens the skill picker).
  const [slashOpen, setSlashOpen] = useState(false);
  const [slashQuery, setSlashQuery] = useState("");
  const [slashIndex, setSlashIndex] = useState(0);
  const [slashKeyboard, setSlashKeyboard] = useState(false);

  // @-mention palette (typing "@" opens data sources / connectors).
  const [atOpen, setAtOpen] = useState(false);
  const [atQuery, setAtQuery] = useState("");
  const [atIndex, setAtIndex] = useState(0);
  const [atKeyboard, setAtKeyboard] = useState(false);

  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const editorRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const plusRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const menuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const controlsRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const measureRef = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const fileRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [menuAnchor, setMenuAnchor] = useState<{
    left: number;
    bottom: number;
  } | null>(null);
  const savedRange = useRef<Range | null>(null);
  const nextId = useRef(1);
  const slashOpenRef = useRef(false);
  const slashIndexRef = useRef(0);
  const slashResultsRef = useRef<PromptInputSkill[]>([]);
  const slashQueryRef = useRef("");
  const slashTokenRef = useRef<{
    node: Text;
    start: number;
    end: number;
  } | null>(null);
  const atOpenRef = useRef(false);
  const atIndexRef = useRef(0);
  const atResultsRef = useRef<PromptInputSource[]>([]);
  const atQueryRef = useRef("");
  const atTokenRef = useRef<{
    node: Text;
    start: number;
    end: number;
  } | null>(null);
  const ignoreHoverRef = useRef(false);
  const applySlashRef = useRef<(id: string) => void>(() => {});
  const applyAtRef = useRef<(id: string) => void>(() => {});
  const handlePaletteKeyRef = useRef<
    (e: {
      key: string;
      preventDefault: () => void;
      stopPropagation?: () => void;
    }) => boolean
  >(() => false);
  const paletteKeyLock = useRef(false);

  const reduceMotion = useReducedMotion();
  const { frameRef, snapshot: snapshotFrame } = useFrameMorph(
    expanded,
    reduceMotion
  );
  const hasText = value.trim().length > 0;
  const sendActive = hasText || attachments.length > 0;
  const slashQueryLower = slashQuery.toLowerCase();
  const slashResults = skills.filter((sk) => {
    if (sk.name.toLowerCase().includes(slashQueryLower)) {
      return true;
    }
    return (sk.desc ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(slashQueryLower);
  });
  const atQueryLower = atQuery.toLowerCase();
  const atResults = sources.filter((src) => {
    if (src.name.toLowerCase().includes(atQueryLower)) {
      return true;
    }
    return (src.desc ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(atQueryLower);
  });
  const atSections = (
    [
      { id: "add", label: "Add" },
      { id: "plugins", label: "Plugins" },
    ] as const
  )
    .map((section) => ({
      ...section,
      items: atResults.filter((src) => sourceSection(src) === section.id),
    }))
    .filter((section) => section.items.length > 0);
  slashOpenRef.current = slashOpen;
  slashIndexRef.current = slashIndex;
  slashResultsRef.current = slashResults;
  atOpenRef.current = atOpen;
  atIndexRef.current = atIndex;
  atResultsRef.current = atResults;

  // Focus the editor and drop the caret at the very end of its content.
  const focusEnd = () => {
    const editor = editorRef.current;
    if (!editor) {
      return;
    }
    editor.focus();
    const range = document.createRange();
    range.selectNodeContents(editor);
    range.collapse(false);
    const sel = window.getSelection();
    sel?.removeAllRanges();
    sel?.addRange(range);
    savedRange.current = range.cloneRange();
  };

  const syncFromEditor = () => {
    const editor = editorRef.current;
    if (!editor) {
      return;
    }
    setValue(editor.textContent ?? "");
    // Mark pills that sit at the very start (nothing but whitespace before them)
    // so the data-[start]:ml-0 utility can drop their left margin —
    // :first-child can't see text nodes.
    for (const pill of editor.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(
      "[data-skill], [data-source]"
    )) {
      let atStart = true;
      for (let n = pill.previousSibling; n; n = n.previousSibling) {
        if (
          n.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE &&
          (n.textContent ?? "").trim() === ""
        ) {
          continue;
        }
        atStart = false;
        break;
      }
      pill.toggleAttribute("data-start", atStart);
    }
  };

  // Remember the last caret position so the "+" menu can insert at it even
  // after the editor loses focus.
  const saveSelection = () => {
    const editor = editorRef.current;
    const sel = window.getSelection();
    if (sel?.rangeCount && editor?.contains(sel.anchorNode)) {
      savedRange.current = sel.getRangeAt(0).cloneRange();
    }
  };

  const closeSlash = () => {
    setSlashOpen(false);
    setSlashQuery("");
    setSlashIndex(0);
    setSlashKeyboard(false);
    slashQueryRef.current = "";
    slashTokenRef.current = null;
    ignoreHoverRef.current = false;
  };

  const closeAt = () => {
    setAtOpen(false);
    setAtQuery("");
    setAtIndex(0);
    setAtKeyboard(false);
    atQueryRef.current = "";
    atTokenRef.current = null;
    ignoreHoverRef.current = false;
  };

  const closePalettes = () => {
    closeSlash();
    closeAt();
  };

  // Build a skill pill node (contenteditable=false so it deletes as a unit).
  const buildSkillPill = (id: string) => {
    const name = skills.find((sk) => sk.id === id)?.name ?? id;
    const el = document.createElement("span");
    el.className = SKILL_PILL;
    el.setAttribute("contenteditable", "false");
    el.dataset.skill = id;
    el.innerHTML =
      `<span class="${SKILL_PILL_LABEL}">/${escapeHtml(name)}</span>` +
      `<button type="button" class="${
        SKILL_PILL_X
      }" data-remove="1" aria-label="Remove ${escapeHtml(
        name
      )}"><svg width="11" height="11" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12"/></svg></button>`;
    return el;
  };

  const buildSourcePill = (id: string) => {
    const source = sources.find((src) => src.id === id);
    const name = source?.name ?? id;
    const brand = source?.brand;
    const el = document.createElement("span");
    el.setAttribute("contenteditable", "false");
    el.dataset.source = id;

    const removeBtn = `<button type="button" class="${
      SOURCE_PILL_X
    }" data-remove="1" aria-label="Remove ${escapeHtml(
      name
    )}"><svg width="11" height="11" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12"/></svg></button>`;

    // Brand connectors: white chip + product mark + "Add {name}".
    if (brand && SOURCE_BRAND_SVG[brand]) {
      el.className = SOURCE_BRAND_PILL;
      el.dataset.brand = brand;
      el.innerHTML =
        `<span class="${SOURCE_BRAND_PILL_ICON}">${
          SOURCE_BRAND_SVG[brand]
        }</span>` +
        `<span class="${SKILL_PILL_LABEL}">Add ${escapeHtml(name)}</span>${
          removeBtn
        }`;
      return el;
    }

    // Data sources: soft-fill chip + glyph well + name (distinct from plugins).
    el.className = SOURCE_DATA_PILL;
    el.dataset.kind = "data";
    el.innerHTML =
      `<span class="${SOURCE_DATA_PILL_ICON}">${sourceDataGlyphSvg(
        source
      )}</span>` +
      `<span class="${SKILL_PILL_LABEL}">${escapeHtml(name)}</span>${
        removeBtn
      }`;
    return el;
  };

  // Replace `range` with a pill + trailing space, then park the caret after it.
  const insertPillOverRange = (range: Range, pill: HTMLElement) => {
    const editor = editorRef.current;
    if (!editor) {
      return;
    }
    range.deleteContents();
    range.insertNode(pill);
    const space = document.createTextNode("\u00A0");
    pill.after(space);
    const after = document.createRange();
    after.setStartAfter(space);
    after.collapse(true);
    const sel = window.getSelection();
    sel?.removeAllRanges();
    sel?.addRange(after);
    editor.focus();
    savedRange.current = after.cloneRange();
    syncFromEditor();
  };

  const rangeFromSavedOrEnd = (): Range | null => {
    const editor = editorRef.current;
    if (!editor) {
      return null;
    }
    const sel = window.getSelection();
    if (sel?.rangeCount && editor.contains(sel.anchorNode)) {
      return sel.getRangeAt(0).cloneRange();
    }
    if (
      savedRange.current &&
      editor.contains(savedRange.current.startContainer)
    ) {
      return savedRange.current.cloneRange();
    }
    const range = document.createRange();
    range.selectNodeContents(editor);
    range.collapse(false);
    return range;
  };

  const removeTokenRange = (
    tokenRef: typeof slashTokenRef,
    caretPattern: RegExp
  ): Range | null => {
    const editor = editorRef.current;
    if (!editor) {
      return null;
    }
    const token = tokenRef.current;
    if (
      token?.node.isConnected &&
      editor.contains(token.node) &&
      token.end <= (token.node.textContent?.length ?? 0)
    ) {
      const range = document.createRange();
      range.setStart(token.node, token.start);
      range.setEnd(token.node, token.end);
      return range;
    }
    const sel = window.getSelection();
    if (!sel?.rangeCount) {
      return null;
    }
    const caret = sel.getRangeAt(0);
    const node = caret.startContainer;
    if (node.nodeType !== Node.TEXT_NODE || !editor.contains(node)) {
      return null;
    }
    const before = (node.textContent ?? "").slice(0, caret.startOffset);
    const m = before.match(caretPattern);
    if (!m) {
      return null;
    }
    const range = document.createRange();
    range.setStart(node, caret.startOffset - m[0].length);
    range.setEnd(node, caret.startOffset);
    return range;
  };

  // Insert from the "+" menu: use the current/last caret, else append at end.
  const addSkillFromMenu = (id: string) => {
    const range = rangeFromSavedOrEnd();
    if (!range) {
      return;
    }
    insertPillOverRange(range, buildSkillPill(id));
    setMenuOpen(false);
  };

  const addSourceFromMenu = (id: string) => {
    const source = sources.find((src) => src.id === id);
    if (source?.attach) {
      openPicker("file");
      return;
    }
    const range = rangeFromSavedOrEnd();
    if (!range) {
      return;
    }
    insertPillOverRange(range, buildSourcePill(id));
    setMenuOpen(false);
  };

  // Insert from a "/" command: swallow the typed "/query" then drop the pill.
  const applySlash = (id: string) => {
    const range = removeTokenRange(slashTokenRef, SLASH_TOKEN_AT_CARET);
    if (!range) {
      closeSlash();
      return;
    }
    insertPillOverRange(range, buildSkillPill(id));
    closeSlash();
  };
  applySlashRef.current = applySlash;

  // Insert from an "@" mention: swallow "@query", or open the file picker.
  const applyAt = (id: string) => {
    const source = sources.find((src) => src.id === id);
    const range = removeTokenRange(atTokenRef, AT_TOKEN_AT_CARET);
    if (source?.attach) {
      if (range) {
        range.deleteContents();
        syncFromEditor();
      }
      closeAt();
      openPicker("file");
      return;
    }
    if (!range) {
      closeAt();
      return;
    }
    insertPillOverRange(range, buildSourcePill(id));
    closeAt();
  };
  applyAtRef.current = applyAt;

  // Open the skill palette when the caret sits right after a "/" token.
  const detectSlash = () => {
    const editor = editorRef.current;
    if (!editor) {
      return closeSlash();
    }
    const caret = getCollapsedCaretInEditor(editor);
    if (!caret) {
      return closeSlash();
    }
    const m = caret.before.match(SLASH_TOKEN_AFTER_BOUNDARY);
    if (!m) {
      return closeSlash();
    }
    closeAt();
    const q = m[1];
    const slashStart = caret.before.length - m[1].length - 1;
    slashTokenRef.current = {
      end: caret.offset,
      node: caret.node,
      start: slashStart,
    };
    if (q !== slashQueryRef.current) {
      slashQueryRef.current = q;
      setSlashIndex(0);
    }
    setSlashQuery(q);
    setSlashOpen(true);
  };

  // Open the sources palette when the caret sits right after an "@" token.
  const detectAt = () => {
    const editor = editorRef.current;
    if (!editor) {
      return closeAt();
    }
    const caret = getCollapsedCaretInEditor(editor);
    if (!caret) {
      return closeAt();
    }
    // Prefer slash if both somehow match; "/" wins when typed last.
    if (SLASH_TOKEN_AFTER_BOUNDARY.test(caret.before)) {
      return closeAt();
    }
    const m = caret.before.match(AT_TOKEN_AFTER_BOUNDARY);
    if (!m) {
      return closeAt();
    }
    closeSlash();
    const q = m[1];
    const atStart = caret.before.length - m[1].length - 1;
    atTokenRef.current = {
      end: caret.offset,
      node: caret.node,
      start: atStart,
    };
    if (q !== atQueryRef.current) {
      atQueryRef.current = q;
      setAtIndex(0);
    }
    setAtQuery(q);
    setAtOpen(true);
  };

  const onEditorInput = () => {
    syncFromEditor();
    if (menuOpen) {
      setMenuOpen(false);
    }
    detectSlash();
    detectAt();
  };

  const moveSlash = (delta: number) => {
    const results = slashResultsRef.current;
    if (!results.length) {
      return;
    }
    ignoreHoverRef.current = true;
    setSlashKeyboard(true);
    setSlashIndex((i) => (i + delta + results.length * 10) % results.length);
  };

  const moveAt = (delta: number) => {
    const results = atResultsRef.current;
    if (!results.length) {
      return;
    }
    ignoreHoverRef.current = true;
    setAtKeyboard(true);
    setAtIndex((i) => (i + delta + results.length * 10) % results.length);
  };

  const runPaletteAction = (
    key: string,
    slashActive: boolean,
    results: { id: string }[]
  ) => {
    if (key === "ArrowDown" || key === "ArrowUp") {
      const delta = key === "ArrowDown" ? 1 : -1;
      if (slashActive) {
        moveSlash(delta);
      } else {
        moveAt(delta);
      }
      return;
    }
    const index = slashActive ? slashIndexRef.current : atIndexRef.current;
    const apply = slashActive ? applySlashRef : applyAtRef;
    apply.current((results[index] ?? results[0]).id);
  };

  const handlePaletteKey = (e: {
    key: string;
    preventDefault: () => void;
    stopPropagation?: () => void;
  }) => {
    const slashActive = slashOpenRef.current;
    const atActive = atOpenRef.current;
    if (!(slashActive || atActive)) {
      return false;
    }
    if (!PALETTE_NAV_KEYS.has(e.key)) {
      return false;
    }
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation?.();
    if (e.key === "Escape") {
      closePalettes();
      return true;
    }
    const results = slashActive
      ? slashResultsRef.current
      : atResultsRef.current;
    if (!results.length || paletteKeyLock.current) {
      return true;
    }
    paletteKeyLock.current = true;
    queueMicrotask(() => {
      paletteKeyLock.current = false;
    });
    runPaletteAction(e.key, slashActive, results);
    return true;
  };
  handlePaletteKeyRef.current = handlePaletteKey;

  const onEditorKeyDown = (e: ReactKeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (handlePaletteKey(e)) {
      return;
    }
    if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      send();
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!(slashOpen || atOpen)) {
      return;
    }
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      handlePaletteKeyRef.current(e);
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey, true);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey, true);
  }, [slashOpen, atOpen]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!(slashOpen && slashResults.length)) {
      return;
    }
    if (slashIndex >= slashResults.length) {
      setSlashIndex(0);
    }
  }, [slashOpen, slashResults.length, slashIndex]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!(atOpen && atResults.length)) {
      return;
    }
    if (atIndex >= atResults.length) {
      setAtIndex(0);
    }
  }, [atOpen, atResults.length, atIndex]);

  const onEditorClick = (e: ReactMouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const remove = (e.target as HTMLElement).closest("[data-remove]");
    if (remove) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const pill = remove.closest<HTMLElement>("[data-skill], [data-source]");
      if (pill) {
        // the separator space we inserted right after the pill — drop it too
        // on removal so leftover spaces can't accumulate and shift the next
        // pill out of alignment.
        const sep = pill.nextSibling;
        // collapse the pill's footprint (width + margins + padding) in sync with
        // the fade so following text slides in smoothly instead of snapping.
        // These nodes live inside the contenteditable (outside React), so the
        // exit uses Motion's imperative animate() rather than a component.
        const w = pill.getBoundingClientRect().width;
        pill.style.maxWidth = `${w}px`;
        pill.style.overflow = "hidden";
        pill.style.whiteSpace = "nowrap";
        pill.style.pointerEvents = "none";
        let done = false;
        const finish = () => {
          if (done) {
            return;
          }
          done = true;
          if (
            sep &&
            sep.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE &&
            sep.textContent?.startsWith("\u00A0")
          ) {
            const rest = sep.textContent.slice(1);
            if (rest) {
              sep.textContent = rest;
            } else {
              sep.parentNode?.removeChild(sep);
            }
          }
          pill.remove();
          syncFromEditor();
          editorRef.current?.focus();
        };
        if (reduceMotion) {
          finish();
          return;
        }
        // fade the pill out, then drop the node
        animate(
          pill,
          {
            filter: "blur(2px)",
            marginLeft: "0px",
            marginRight: "0px",
            maxWidth: "0px",
            opacity: 0,
            paddingLeft: "0px",
            paddingRight: "0px",
            scale: 0.96,
          },
          { duration: 0.18, ease: EASE }
        ).then(finish);
        setTimeout(finish, 260);
      }
      return;
    }
    saveSelection();
  };

  // Dismiss the "+" menu on outside click / Escape.
  // Menu renders outside the frame (sibling of plusRef), so check both.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!menuOpen) {
      return;
    }
    const onDown = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      const target = e.target as Node;
      if (
        !(
          plusRef.current?.contains(target) || menuRef.current?.contains(target)
        )
      ) {
        setMenuOpen(false);
      }
    };
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") {
        setMenuOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("pointerdown", onDown);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", onDown);
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    };
  }, [menuOpen]);

  // Anchor the plus menu to the trigger from outside the frame's overflow clip.
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!menuOpen) {
      return;
    }
    const root = rootRef.current;
    const plus = plusRef.current;
    if (!(root && plus)) {
      return;
    }
    const update = () => {
      const rootRect = root.getBoundingClientRect();
      const plusRect = plus.getBoundingClientRect();
      setMenuAnchor({
        bottom: rootRect.bottom - plusRect.top + 4,
        left: plusRect.left - rootRect.left,
      });
    };
    update();
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(update);
    observer.observe(root);
    observer.observe(plus);
    window.addEventListener("resize", update);
    window.addEventListener("scroll", update, true);
    return () => {
      observer.disconnect();
      window.removeEventListener("resize", update);
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", update, true);
    };
  }, [menuOpen]);

  // Collapse flyouts / model popover whenever the plus menu closes.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!menuOpen) {
      setSkillsOpen(false);
      setSourcesOpen(false);
      setHoveredModel(null);
    }
  }, [menuOpen]);

  /* Move wrapped text above the controls (prompt-bar pattern): measure the
   * unconstrained draft width against the inline slot left beside the trailing
   * controls; expand when it no longer fits, or when inline pills appear. */
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const editor = editorRef.current;
    const controls = controlsRef.current;
    const measure = measureRef.current;
    if (!(editor && controls && measure)) {
      return;
    }

    const trailing = controls.querySelector<HTMLElement>(
      "[data-slot='prompt-input-trailing']"
    );
    const plus = controls.querySelector<HTMLElement>(
      "[data-slot='prompt-input-menu-trigger']"
    );
    const fixedWidth =
      (plus?.offsetWidth ?? 22) + (trailing?.offsetWidth ?? 22);
    const gaps = 4 * 2;
    const inlineInputWidth = controls.clientWidth - fixedWidth - gaps;
    const hasInlinePills = Boolean(
      editor.querySelector("[data-skill], [data-source]")
    );
    const needsFullWidth =
      value.includes("\n") ||
      hasInlinePills ||
      measure.offsetWidth + 8 > inlineInputWidth;

    if (needsFullWidth !== expanded) {
      snapshotFrame(needsFullWidth);
      setExpanded(needsFullWidth);
    }
  }, [value, expanded, snapshotFrame]);

  const openPicker = (kind: PromptInputAttachment["kind"]) => {
    const input = fileRef.current;
    if (!input) {
      return;
    }
    input.accept = kind === "image" ? "image/*" : "";
    input.value = "";
    input.dataset.kind = kind;
    input.click();
    setMenuOpen(false);
  };

  const revokeAttachmentPreview = (att: PromptInputAttachment) => {
    if (att.preview) {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(att.preview);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    attachmentsRef.current = attachments;
  }, [attachments]);

  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      for (const att of attachmentsRef.current) {
        if (att.preview) {
          URL.revokeObjectURL(att.preview);
        }
      }
    },
    []
  );

  const send = () => {
    if (!sendActive) {
      return;
    }
    const editor = editorRef.current;
    if (onSend) {
      const skillIds = editor
        ? [...editor.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("[data-skill]")].flatMap(
            (pill) => (pill.dataset.skill ? [pill.dataset.skill] : [])
          )
        : [];
      const sourceIds = editor
        ? [...editor.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("[data-source]")].flatMap(
            (pill) => (pill.dataset.source ? [pill.dataset.source] : [])
          )
        : [];
      onSend({
        attachments,
        modelId: model,
        skillIds,
        sourceIds,
        text: value.trim(),
      });
    }
    if (editor) {
      editor.innerHTML = "";
    }
    setValue("");
    for (const att of attachmentsRef.current) {
      revokeAttachmentPreview(att);
    }
    setAttachments([]);
    closePalettes();
    requestAnimationFrame(focusEnd);
  };

  // AnimatePresence plays the chip's exit before it leaves the DOM.
  const removeAttachment = (id: number) => {
    setAttachments((a) => {
      const found = a.find((x) => x.id === id);
      if (found) {
        revokeAttachmentPreview(found);
      }
      return a.filter((x) => x.id !== id);
    });
  };

  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        // `relative` anchors the @ / skill / plus menus above the frame without
        // living inside the frame's overflow clip.
        "relative w-full max-w-[480px] min-w-0 font-['Inter_Variable','Inter',sans-serif] [&_svg]:[stroke-width:1.5px]",
        THEME_VARS,
        // Pill softens every nested radius — large attachment tiles echo the
        // 24px tall shell (concentric would be 16; bump to 20 for the capsule feel).
        pill &&
          "[--pi-attachment-radius:16px] [--pi-chip-radius:9999px] [--pi-chip-x-radius:9999px] [--pi-control-radius:9999px]",
        className
      )}
      data-slot="prompt-input"
      data-variant={variant}
      ref={rootRef}
    >
      <input
        hidden
        multiple
        onChange={(e) => {
          const files = [...(e.target.files ?? [])];
          if (!files.length) {
            return;
          }
          const fallback =
            (e.target.dataset.kind as PromptInputAttachment["kind"]) ?? "file";
          setAttachments((a) => [
            ...a,
            ...files.map((f) => {
              const isImage = f.type.startsWith("image/");
              const id = nextId.current;
              nextId.current += 1;
              return {
                file: f,
                id,
                kind: isImage ? ("image" as const) : fallback,
                name: f.name,
                preview: isImage ? URL.createObjectURL(f) : null,
              };
            }),
          ]);
          e.target.value = "";
          requestAnimationFrame(focusEnd);
        }}
        ref={fileRef}
        type="file"
      />

      <div
        className={cn(
          // Single-row shell (prompt-bar): p-2 + gap-1.5.
          // min-w-0 + overflow-hidden keep long drafts from blowing past max-w
          // once the editor goes col-span-full, and clip content while the
          // height morph plays (overflow-x alone would make y scrollable).
          // Safe because @ / skill / plus menus render outside this frame.
          "relative flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-1.5 overflow-hidden border-[0.5px] border-transparent bg-(--pi-surface) p-2 shadow-(--pi-frame-shadow)",
          frameRadiusClass(pill)
        )}
        data-expanded={expanded || undefined}
        data-slot="prompt-input-frame"
        ref={frameRef}
      >
        {/* Measure unconstrained draft width for single-row → expanded. */}
        <span
          aria-hidden="true"
          className="pointer-events-none invisible absolute text-[13px] leading-5 tracking-[-0.12px] whitespace-pre"
          ref={measureRef}
        >
          {value}
        </span>

        {/* The wrapper animates its height open/closed so the frame never
            snaps when the row appears or the last chip leaves. -mb-1.5 cancels
            the frame's flex gap so at height 0 the row contributes 0px.
            `propagate` lets the last chip play its own exit. */}
        <AnimatePresence propagate>
          {attachments.length > 0 && (
            <motion.div
              animate={{ height: "auto", opacity: 1 }}
              className="-mb-1.5 overflow-hidden"
              data-large={largeAttachments || undefined}
              exit={{
                height: 0,
                opacity: 0,
                transition: { duration: reduceMotion ? 0 : 0.18, ease: EASE },
              }}
              initial={reduceMotion ? false : { height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
              key="chips"
              transition={{ duration: 0.2, ease: EASE }}
            >
              <div
                className={cn(
                  // Large tiles need a uniform 8px inset (frame p-2) so their
                  // radius stays concentric; chip pills keep pt-0.5 for optical
                  // alignment with the remove affordance overhang.
                  "flex flex-wrap pb-1.5",
                  largeAttachments ? "gap-2" : "gap-1.5 pt-0.5"
                )}
              >
                <AnimatePresence propagate>
                  {largeAttachments
                    ? attachments.map((att) => (
                        <AttachmentLargeTile
                          attachment={att}
                          key={att.id}
                          onRemove={removeAttachment}
                          reduceMotion={reduceMotion}
                        />
                      ))
                    : attachments.map((att) => (
                        <motion.span
                          animate={{ filter: "blur(0px)", opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                          className={CHIP}
                          exit={{
                            filter: "blur(2px)",
                            opacity: 0,
                            pointerEvents: "none",
                            scale: 0.96,
                            transition: {
                              duration: reduceMotion ? 0 : 0.18,
                              ease: EASE,
                            },
                          }}
                          initial={
                            reduceMotion
                              ? false
                              : { filter: "blur(2px)", opacity: 0, y: 4 }
                          }
                          key={att.id}
                          transition={{ duration: 0.26, ease: EASE }}
                        >
                          <span className="inline-flex flex-none text-(--pi-muted)">
                            {att.kind === "image" ? (
                              <ImageIcon size={13} />
                            ) : (
                              <Paperclip size={13} />
                            )}
                          </span>
                          <span className="max-w-[150px] overflow-hidden text-ellipsis whitespace-nowrap">
                            {att.name}
                          </span>
                          <button
                            aria-label={`Remove ${att.name}`}
                            className="-ml-0.5 inline-flex h-[15px] w-[15px] cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-(--pi-chip-x-radius) border-0 bg-transparent text-(--pi-muted) transition-[background-color,color] duration-150 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)] hover:bg-(--pi-fill-soft) hover:text-(--pi-fg) motion-reduce:transition-none"
                            onClick={() => removeAttachment(att.id)}
                            type="button"
                          >
                            <X size={11} />
                          </button>
                        </motion.span>
                      ))}
                </AnimatePresence>
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          )}
        </AnimatePresence>

        <div
          className={cn(
            "grid min-w-0 gap-x-1.5 gap-y-1.5",
            // minmax(0,1fr) on the flex track so col-span-full drafts can't
            // force the frame wider than max-w (flex/grid min-content quirk).
            expanded
              ? "grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_auto_auto]"
              : "grid-cols-[auto_minmax(0,1fr)_auto]",
            // Single-row: center against the editor. Expanded: baseline to the
            // growing text block (prompt-bar). Avoid self-end on children —
            // that left a dead band above the icon buttons.
            expanded ? "items-end" : "items-center"
          )}
          ref={controlsRef}
        >
          <div
            className={cn(
              "relative flex shrink-0",
              expanded ? "col-start-1 row-start-2" : "col-start-1 row-start-1"
            )}
            data-morph-slot
            ref={plusRef}
          >
            <button
              aria-expanded={menuOpen}
              aria-label="Add attachment or switch model"
              className={cn(
                ICON_BTN,
                "cursor-pointer text-(--pi-fg)",
                menuOpen
                  ? // open state's stronger fill wins over hover, like the
                    // original .plus[data-open] rule did
                    "before:bg-(--pi-fill-open)"
                  : BTN_FILL
              )}
              data-open={menuOpen || undefined}
              data-slot="prompt-input-menu-trigger"
              onClick={() => setMenuOpen((o) => !o)}
              type="button"
            >
              <span
                className={cn(
                  "relative inline-flex transition-transform duration-200 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.35,1.55,0.65,1)] motion-reduce:transition-none",
                  menuOpen && "rotate-45"
                )}
              >
                <Plus size={16} />
              </span>
            </button>
          </div>

          <div
            className={cn(
              "relative max-w-full min-w-0",
              expanded
                ? "col-span-full col-start-1 row-start-1"
                : "col-start-2 row-start-1"
            )}
            data-morph-slot
          >
            {/* biome-ignore lint/a11y/useSemanticElements: contenteditable rich editor cannot be a native <textarea> (skill/source pills) */}
            <div
              aria-label={placeholder}
              aria-multiline="true"
              className="relative m-0 max-h-48 min-h-7 w-full max-w-full min-w-0 overflow-x-hidden overflow-y-auto bg-transparent px-1 py-1 text-[13px] leading-5 tracking-[-0.12px] [overflow-wrap:anywhere] break-words whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--pi-fg) outline-none selection:bg-[color:Highlight] selection:text-[color:HighlightText] before:pointer-events-none before:absolute before:top-1 before:left-1 before:text-(--pi-muted) before:content-[''] data-[empty]:before:content-[attr(data-placeholder)]"
              contentEditable
              data-empty={!hasText || undefined}
              data-placeholder={placeholder}
              data-slot="prompt-input-editor"
              onBlur={saveSelection}
              onClick={onEditorClick}
              onInput={onEditorInput}
              onKeyDown={onEditorKeyDown}
              onKeyUp={saveSelection}
              onMouseUp={saveSelection}
              ref={editorRef}
              role="textbox"
              suppressContentEditableWarning
              tabIndex={0}
            />
          </div>

          <div
            className={cn(
              "flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1",
              expanded ? "col-start-3 row-start-2" : "col-start-3 row-start-1"
            )}
            data-morph-slot
            data-slot="prompt-input-trailing"
          >
            <button
              aria-label="Send"
              className={cn(
                ICON_BTN,
                "cursor-pointer disabled:cursor-default disabled:active:before:transform-none",
                sendActive
                  ? "text-(--pi-send-fg) before:bg-(--pi-send-bg) hover:before:bg-(--pi-send-bg-hover)"
                  : cn("text-(--pi-muted)", BTN_FILL)
              )}
              data-slot="prompt-input-send"
              disabled={!sendActive}
              onClick={send}
              type="button"
            >
              <ArrowUp size={16} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Outside the frame so overflow-x-hidden on the shell can't clip these. */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {menuOpen && menuAnchor && (
          <motion.div
            animate={{ filter: "blur(0px)", opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
            className={cn(
              "absolute z-50 w-[180px] origin-bottom-left p-[3px]",
              MENU_CARD
            )}
            data-slot="prompt-input-menu"
            exit={{
              filter: "blur(2px)",
              opacity: 0,
              pointerEvents: "none",
              scale: 0.98,
              transition: {
                duration: reduceMotion ? 0 : 0.12,
                ease: EASE,
              },
              y: 6,
            }}
            initial={
              reduceMotion
                ? false
                : { filter: "blur(2px)", opacity: 0, scale: 0.98, y: 6 }
            }
            key="plus-menu"
            ref={menuRef}
            role="menu"
            style={{ bottom: menuAnchor.bottom, left: menuAnchor.left }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.2, ease: EASE }}
          >
            <button
              className={MENU_ITEM}
              onClick={() => openPicker("image")}
              role="menuitem"
              type="button"
            >
              <span className={MENU_ICON}>
                <ImageIcon size={14} />
              </span>
              <span className={MENU_NAME}>Add photos</span>
            </button>
            <button
              className={MENU_ITEM}
              onClick={() => openPicker("file")}
              role="menuitem"
              type="button"
            >
              <span className={MENU_ICON}>
                <Paperclip size={14} />
              </span>
              <span className={MENU_NAME}>Attach files</span>
            </button>
            <div className={MENU_DIVIDER} />
            {/* biome-ignore lint/a11y/noStaticElementInteractions: hover bridge keeps Sources flyout open across the gap */}
            {/* biome-ignore lint/a11y/noNoninteractiveElementInteractions: hover bridge keeps Sources flyout open across the gap */}
            <div
              className="relative"
              onMouseEnter={() => {
                setSourcesOpen(true);
                setSkillsOpen(false);
              }}
              onMouseLeave={() => setSourcesOpen(false)}
            >
              <button
                aria-expanded={sourcesOpen}
                aria-haspopup="menu"
                className={MENU_ITEM}
                onClick={() => {
                  setSourcesOpen(true);
                  setSkillsOpen(false);
                }}
                role="menuitem"
                type="button"
              >
                <span className={MENU_ICON}>
                  <AtSign size={14} />
                </span>
                <span className={MENU_NAME}>Sources</span>
                <span className="inline-flex flex-none text-(--pi-muted)">
                  <ChevronRight size={14} />
                </span>
              </button>
              {sourcesOpen && (
                <div
                  className={cn(
                    "absolute -top-[3px] left-[calc(100%+6px)] w-[240px] p-[3px] before:absolute before:inset-y-0 before:-left-[7px] before:w-[7px] before:content-['']",
                    MENU_CARD
                  )}
                  role="menu"
                >
                  {sources.map((src) => (
                    <button
                      className={SOURCE_MENU_ITEM}
                      key={src.id}
                      onClick={() => addSourceFromMenu(src.id)}
                      role="menuitem"
                      type="button"
                    >
                      <span className="inline-flex size-5.5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center text-(--pi-muted)">
                        <SourceGlyph source={src} />
                      </span>
                      <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                        <span className="block truncate text-[12px] font-medium text-(--pi-fg)">
                          {src.name}
                        </span>
                        {src.desc ? (
                          <span className="block truncate text-[11px] text-(--pi-muted)">
                            {src.desc}
                          </span>
                        ) : null}
                      </span>
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            {/* biome-ignore lint/a11y/noStaticElementInteractions: hover bridge keeps Skills flyout open across the gap */}
            {/* biome-ignore lint/a11y/noNoninteractiveElementInteractions: hover bridge keeps Skills flyout open across the gap */}
            <div
              className="relative"
              onMouseEnter={() => {
                setSkillsOpen(true);
                setSourcesOpen(false);
              }}
              onMouseLeave={() => setSkillsOpen(false)}
            >
              <button
                aria-expanded={skillsOpen}
                aria-haspopup="menu"
                className={MENU_ITEM}
                onClick={() => {
                  setSkillsOpen(true);
                  setSourcesOpen(false);
                }}
                role="menuitem"
                type="button"
              >
                <span className={MENU_ICON}>
                  <BookOpen size={14} />
                </span>
                <span className={MENU_NAME}>Skills</span>
                <span className="inline-flex flex-none text-(--pi-muted)">
                  <ChevronRight size={14} />
                </span>
              </button>
              {skillsOpen && (
                // invisible ::before bridge across the 6px gap so the hover
                // doesn't drop when the pointer travels into the flyout
                <div
                  className={cn(
                    "absolute -top-[3px] left-[calc(100%+6px)] w-[168px] p-[3px] before:absolute before:inset-y-0 before:-left-[7px] before:w-[7px] before:content-['']",
                    MENU_CARD
                  )}
                  role="menu"
                >
                  {skills.map((sk) => (
                    <button
                      className={MENU_ITEM}
                      key={sk.id}
                      onClick={() => addSkillFromMenu(sk.id)}
                      role="menuitem"
                      type="button"
                    >
                      <span className={MENU_ICON}>
                        <SkillGlyph skill={sk} />
                      </span>
                      <span className={MENU_NAME}>{sk.name}</span>
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            <div className={MENU_DIVIDER} />
            <div className={MENU_LABEL}>Model</div>
            {models.map((m) => (
              <div className="relative" key={m.id}>
                <button
                  aria-checked={model === m.id}
                  className={MENU_ITEM}
                  onClick={() => {
                    setModel(m.id);
                    onModelChange?.(m.id);
                    setMenuOpen(false);
                  }}
                  onMouseEnter={() => setHoveredModel(m.id)}
                  onMouseLeave={() => setHoveredModel(null)}
                  role="menuitemradio"
                  type="button"
                >
                  {/* brand marks keep their own colours; ChatGPT is
                    monochrome so it follows text */}
                  <span className="inline-flex flex-none text-(--pi-fg)">
                    {m.icon ?? <ModelIcon id={m.id} />}
                  </span>
                  <span className={MENU_NAME}>{m.name}</span>
                  {model === m.id && (
                    <span className="inline-flex flex-none text-(--pi-fg)">
                      <Check size={14} />
                    </span>
                  )}
                </button>
                {hoveredModel === m.id && (
                  <div
                    className={cn(
                      "pointer-events-none absolute -top-[3px] left-[calc(100%+6px)] z-30 w-[200px] px-3 py-2.5",
                      MENU_CARD
                    )}
                    role="tooltip"
                  >
                    <div className="text-xs leading-4 font-medium text-(--pi-fg)">
                      {m.name}
                    </div>
                    <p className="m-0 mt-0.5 text-[11px] leading-[15px] text-(--pi-muted)">
                      {m.desc}
                    </p>
                    <div className="mt-2 text-[11px] leading-[14px] text-(--pi-muted)">
                      {m.context}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            ))}
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
      <AnimatePresence>
        {slashOpen && (
          <motion.div
            animate={{ filter: "blur(0px)", opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
            aria-label="Skills"
            className={cn(
              "group absolute inset-x-0 bottom-[calc(100%+12px)] z-50 w-full max-w-full origin-bottom overflow-hidden p-1.5",
              MENU_CARD
            )}
            data-keyboard={slashKeyboard || undefined}
            data-slot="prompt-input-slash-menu"
            exit={{
              filter: "blur(2px)",
              opacity: 0,
              pointerEvents: "none",
              scale: 0.98,
              transition: {
                duration: reduceMotion ? 0 : 0.12,
                ease: EASE,
              },
              y: 6,
            }}
            initial={
              reduceMotion
                ? false
                : { filter: "blur(2px)", opacity: 0, scale: 0.98, y: 6 }
            }
            key="slash-menu"
            onMouseMove={() => {
              ignoreHoverRef.current = false;
              if (slashKeyboard) {
                setSlashKeyboard(false);
              }
            }}
            role="listbox"
            transition={{ duration: 0.2, ease: EASE }}
          >
            {slashResults.length ? (
              slashResults.map((sk, i) => (
                <button
                  aria-selected={i === slashIndex}
                  className={cn(
                    SKILL_MENU_ITEM,
                    i === slashIndex
                      ? // keyboard-selected row keeps the tint even in
                        // keyboard mode (hover suppression below doesn't
                        // apply to it)
                        "bg-(--pi-fill)"
                      : // while navigating by keyboard, mouse hover on the
                        // other rows paints nothing
                        "group-data-[keyboard]:hover:bg-transparent"
                  )}
                  key={sk.id}
                  onClick={() => applySlash(sk.id)}
                  onMouseDown={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
                  onMouseEnter={() => {
                    if (ignoreHoverRef.current) {
                      return;
                    }
                    setSlashIndex(i);
                  }}
                  role="option"
                  type="button"
                >
                  <span className="inline-flex size-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center text-(--pi-muted) [&_svg]:block">
                    <SkillGlyph skill={sk} />
                  </span>
                  <span className="min-w-0 shrink truncate text-[13px] leading-none font-medium text-(--pi-fg)">
                    {sk.name}
                  </span>
                  {sk.desc ? (
                    <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-right text-[12px] leading-none text-(--pi-muted)">
                      {sk.desc}
                    </span>
                  ) : null}
                </button>
              ))
            ) : (
              <div className="flex h-9 items-center px-2.5 text-[13px] text-(--pi-muted)">
                No matching skills
              </div>
            )}
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      <AnimatePresence>
        {atOpen && (
          <motion.div
            animate={{ filter: "blur(0px)", opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
            aria-label="Sources"
            className={cn(
              "group absolute inset-x-0 bottom-[calc(100%+12px)] z-50 w-full max-w-full origin-bottom overflow-hidden p-1.5",
              MENU_CARD
            )}
            data-keyboard={atKeyboard || undefined}
            data-slot="prompt-input-at-menu"
            exit={{
              filter: "blur(2px)",
              opacity: 0,
              pointerEvents: "none",
              scale: 0.98,
              transition: {
                duration: reduceMotion ? 0 : 0.12,
                ease: EASE,
              },
              y: 6,
            }}
            initial={
              reduceMotion
                ? false
                : { filter: "blur(2px)", opacity: 0, scale: 0.98, y: 6 }
            }
            key="at-menu"
            onMouseMove={() => {
              ignoreHoverRef.current = false;
              if (atKeyboard) {
                setAtKeyboard(false);
              }
            }}
            role="listbox"
            transition={{ duration: 0.2, ease: EASE }}
          >
            {atResults.length ? (
              atSections.map((section) => (
                <div data-slot="prompt-input-at-section" key={section.id}>
                  <div className={AT_MENU_SECTION_LABEL}>{section.label}</div>
                  {section.items.map((src) => {
                    const i = atResults.findIndex((s) => s.id === src.id);
                    return (
                      <button
                        aria-selected={i === atIndex}
                        className={cn(
                          AT_MENU_ITEM,
                          i === atIndex
                            ? "bg-(--pi-fill)"
                            : "group-data-[keyboard]:hover:bg-transparent"
                        )}
                        key={src.id}
                        onClick={() => applyAt(src.id)}
                        onMouseDown={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
                        onMouseEnter={() => {
                          if (ignoreHoverRef.current) {
                            return;
                          }
                          setAtIndex(i);
                        }}
                        role="option"
                        type="button"
                      >
                        <span className="inline-flex size-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center text-(--pi-muted) [&_svg]:block">
                          <SourceGlyph source={src} />
                        </span>
                        <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-[13px] leading-none">
                          <span className="font-medium text-(--pi-fg)">
                            {src.name}
                          </span>
                          {src.desc ? (
                            <span className="text-(--pi-muted)">
                              {" "}
                              {src.desc}
                            </span>
                          ) : null}
                        </span>
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              ))
            ) : (
              <div className="flex h-9 items-center px-2.5 text-[13px] text-(--pi-muted)">
                No matches for “{atQuery}”
              </div>
            )}
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );
}
